query.sql: SELECT v.scenario_name, x."口径", x."收益率（%）" FROM vi_valuation v JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = v.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('隐含收益率', round((v.implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('现金支持口径', round((v.cash_implied_irr * 100)::numeric, 2)), ('要求收益率', round((v.required_return * 100)::numeric, 2))) x("口径", "收益率（%）") ORDER BY v.sort, 2

query.sql: SELECT m.code || ' ' || left(m.title, 14) AS "壁垒", CASE m.strength WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 WHEN '弱' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "强度", coalesce(m.verdict, '待验证') AS "判定" FROM vi_moat_base m JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' ORDER BY m.code

query.sql: SELECT v.code || ' ' || left(v.participant, 12) AS "环节", v.force AS "五力", CASE v.power WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * CASE v.effect WHEN '有利' THEN 1 WHEN '不利' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS "影响" FROM vi_value_chain_base v JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = v.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' ORDER BY v.code

query.sql: SELECT c.name AS "对手", x.k AS "指标", round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "%" FROM vi_competitor_base c JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = c.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('付费率或渗透率', c.paying_rate), ('毛利率', c.gross_margin), ('增速', c.growth)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.name || '（本公司）', x.k, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_fin_history_calc hc USING (id) JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', hc.gross_margin), ('增速', hc.revenue_yoy)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL AND h.year = (SELECT max(h2.year) FROM vi_fin_history_base h2 WHERE h2.company_id = h.company_id) ORDER BY 1, 2

query.sql: SELECT f.dimension AS "维度", f.score AS "评分" FROM vi_fit_score_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' ORDER BY f.sort, f.id

titleDescription.title: 价投适配度（各维度 0—5 分）

query.sql: SELECT m.code || ' ' || left(m.title, 14) AS "壁垒", CASE m.strength WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 WHEN '弱' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "强度", coalesce(m.verdict, '待验证') AS "判定" FROM vi_moat_base m JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' ORDER BY m.code

titleDescription.title: 竞争壁垒：强度（强 3、中 2、弱 1、无 0）与判定

query.sql: SELECT v.code || ' ' || left(v.participant, 12) AS "环节", v.force AS "五力", CASE v.power WHEN '强' THEN 3 WHEN '中' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * CASE v.effect WHEN '有利' THEN 1 WHEN '不利' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END AS "影响" FROM vi_value_chain_base v JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = v.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' ORDER BY v.code

titleDescription.title: 产业链与五力：对公司的影响（有利为正、不利为负，强 3、中 2、弱 1）

query.sql: SELECT c.name AS "对手", x.k AS "指标", round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "%" FROM vi_competitor_base c JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = c.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('付费率或渗透率', c.paying_rate), ('毛利率', c.gross_margin), ('增速', c.growth)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT co.name || '（本公司）', x.k, round((x.v * 100)::numeric, 1) FROM vi_fin_history_base h JOIN vi_fin_history_calc hc USING (id) JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('毛利率', hc.gross_margin), ('增速', hc.revenue_yoy)) x(k, v) WHERE x.v IS NOT NULL AND h.year = (SELECT max(h2.year) FROM vi_fin_history_base h2 WHERE h2.company_id = h.company_id) ORDER BY 1, 2

titleDescription.title: 竞争对手对比（%）：付费率、毛利率、增速

query.sql: SELECT coalesce(t.status, '未裁决') AS "裁决", count(*) AS n FROM vi_thesis_base t JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = t.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

titleDescription.title: 核心论点：裁决（成立 / 观察 / 存疑 / 证伪）

query.sql: SELECT d.period, d.line_item, round((d.yoy * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "同比（%）" FROM vi_period_data_base d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.yoy IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.period_end, d.line_item

titleDescription.title: 经营数据：单季同比（%）

query.sql: SELECT k.result, count(*) AS n FROM vi_check k JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id = k.model_id JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = m.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' JOIN vi_model_base m0 ON m0.id = m.id AND m0.status = '当前' GROUP BY k.result ORDER BY k.result

titleDescription.title: 自动检查结果

query.sql: SELECT f.verify_status, count(*) AS n FROM vi_fact_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' GROUP BY f.verify_status ORDER BY n DESC

titleDescription.title: 事实摘录核验状态

query.sql: SELECT o.obs_date, round((CASE WHEN co.price_fx_metric_id IS NULL THEN o.value ELSE o.value * fx.value END)::numeric, 2) AS "股价" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.price_metric_id = o.metric_id AND co.code = '600900.SH' LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x.value FROM vi_obs_current x WHERE x.metric_id = co.price_fx_metric_id AND x.obs_date <= o.obs_date ORDER BY x.obs_date DESC LIMIT 1) fx ON true ORDER BY o.obs_date

titleDescription.title: 市场：股价（元；境外报价按当日汇率折算）

query.sql: SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'CGB10Y.CCDC' ORDER BY o.obs_date

titleDescription.title: 市场：中债国债10年收益率（%）

query.sql: SELECT o.obs_date, o.value AS "数值" FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_metric_base mt ON mt.id = o.metric_id WHERE mt.code = 'SX.LEVEL' ORDER BY o.obs_date

titleDescription.title: 市场：三峡水库水位（米）
